messages.subject: FAQ description of inla.make.lincombs flipped?
parts:
Hi guys,

The FAQ for inla.make.lincombs says

## plural 's'].  Here each 'column' define one linear combination

Consider

A <- matrix(rnorm(15),5,3)
lc <- inla.make.lincombs(ID = A)
length(lc)

returns 5.  So it seems like each row defines a linear combination?  Or am I misinterpreting the comment?

Alex
